en.lede: A document framework for coding agents: describe the report, your agent writes React, and open-doc handles page size, contents, page numbers, print layout and export. For anyone who needs a PDF that survives a printer.
features: Pages render at true A4, JIS B4 or A3 size, so the PDF matches what you see on screen.
flow() measures content in the real DOM: headings never end a page and tables move whole.
open-doc check reports clipped content, stranded headings and missing images, with the source line.
Inspect mode rewrites text straight into the source, or leaves a note for your agent.
Import a .csv or .tsv file and it becomes a captioned, numbered table that updates with the file.
Every workspace ships with authoring skills, and open-doc dev --mcp exposes 26 tools.
en.prompt: Turn notes.md into a Q3 infrastructure review with a cover page and contents

zh.lede: 為 Coding Agent 打造的文件框架：你描述要的報告，Agent 寫 React，open-doc 處理頁面尺寸、目錄、頁碼、列印版面與匯出。適合需要一份經得起印表機考驗的 PDF 的人。
features: 頁面以真正的 A4、JIS B4 或 A3 尺寸呈現，PDF 與螢幕上看到的一致。
flow() 在真實 DOM 中量測內容：標題不會落在頁尾，表格整張移動。
open-doc check 會列出被裁切的內容、落單的標題與載入失敗的圖片，並附上原始碼行號。
Inspect 模式把改寫的文字直接寫回原始碼，或留一則註記給 Agent。
匯入 .csv 或 .tsv 檔就成為有編號與標題的表格，檔案一改表格就跟著改。
每個工作區都附上撰寫用的 Skills，open-doc dev --mcp 提供 26 個工具。
zh.prompt: 把 notes.md 整理成一份第三季基礎架構檢討報告，要有封面和目錄

alt.en: The open-doc viewer: a Q3 infrastructure review, page by page
alt.zh: open-doc 檢視器：一份第三季基礎架構檢討報告

open-dashboard.dev: cd my-dashboards && pnpm install && pnpm dev

en.lede: A dashboard framework for coding agents: your agent writes the SQL and the panels, and open-dashboard runs every query read-only against your own database and renders the charts. For teams who want dashboards as reviewable files instead of a BI tool.
features: The browser names a query and never sends SQL; every engine runs it read-only.
queries.sql defines the numbers and index.tsx lays out the panels, so a diff shows what changed.
Hand-written SVG charts, from stat tiles and line charts to Sankey diagrams and maps.
Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, SQLite and more, plus HTTP APIs, MCP servers and CSV or JSON files.
open-dashboard check runs every query and verifies each column and parameter a panel names.
See a panel's SQL, rows and timing, and leave a note your agent turns into the next edit.
en.prompt: Add weekly signups by plan and the 20 most active accounts from our Postgres

zh.lede: 為 Coding Agent 打造的 Dashboard 框架：Agent 寫 SQL 與面板，open-dashboard 以唯讀方式在你自己的資料庫上執行每條查詢並畫出圖表。適合想把 Dashboard 當成可審查的檔案、而不是 BI 工具的團隊。
features: 瀏覽器只能點名查詢，永遠不送 SQL；每種資料庫都以唯讀方式執行。
一張 Dashboard 兩個檔案
queries.sql 定義數字，index.tsx 排面板，diff 一看就知道改了什麼。
手寫 SVG 圖表，從數字卡、折線圖到 Sankey 圖與地圖。
Postgres、MySQL、BigQuery、Snowflake、SQLite 等，也能接 HTTP API、MCP server 與 CSV、JSON 檔。
open-dashboard check 執行每條查詢，並驗證面板用到的每個欄位與參數。
看面板的 SQL、筆數與耗時，留一則備註讓 Agent 接著改。
zh.prompt: 從我們的 Postgres 加上各方案每週註冊數，以及用量最多的 20 個帳號

alt.en: An open-dashboard sales overview over a fictional coffee shop
alt.zh: open-dashboard 銷售總覽（虛構的咖啡店資料）

open-spreadsheet.dev: cd my-sheets && pnpm install && pnpm dev

en.lede: An Excel-like spreadsheet where each workbook is one JSON file of what people typed, so a person edits it in a real grid and an agent edits the file. For teams who want their numbers in git.
features: 337 functions following Excel's rules, with no spreadsheet library underneath.
Formula bar, number formats, merges, frozen panes, filters, notes and sheet tabs.
Cells store what was typed, including formulas, so git shows every change.
Import .csv, .tsv or .xlsx and download .xlsx or CSV, without uploading anything.
Locked cells refuse typing, pasting and MCP writes, so an agent cannot change them.
Every write recalculates and is refused if the file changed since it was read.
en.prompt: Build a 2026 budget sheet with monthly totals and a running balance

zh.display: 人和 Agent 共用的試算表
zh.lede: 用起來像 Excel 的試算表，每份活頁簿都是一個 JSON 檔，存的是人輸入的內容：人在格子裡編輯，Agent 直接改檔案。適合想把數字放進 git 的團隊。
features: 337 個函數，照 Excel 的規則計算，底層沒有任何試算表套件。
像 Excel 的格子介面
公式列、數值格式、合併儲存格、凍結窗格、篩選、註解與工作表分頁。
一份活頁簿一個 JSON 檔
儲存格存的是輸入的內容（包含公式），git 看得到每一處修改。
CSV 與 Excel 匯入匯出
匯入 .csv、.tsv 或 .xlsx，下載 .xlsx 或 CSV，什麼都不會上傳。
鎖定的儲存格拒絕輸入、貼上與 MCP 寫入，Agent 改不了人鎖住的內容。
每次寫入都會重算，檔案在讀取後被改過就拒絕寫入。
zh.prompt: 做一份 2026 年預算表，要有每月合計和累計餘額

open-form.init: git clone https://github.com/simonliu-ai-product/open-form.git && cd open-form && pnpm install

en.display: Forms and surveys your agent writes
en.lede: A form framework for coding agents: describe the survey, registration or quiz, your agent writes the TSX, and open-form handles layout, logic, validation and response storage. For anyone collecting answers without a hosted form service.
features: One TSX file renders as a single page, a step-by-step wizard or one question at a time.
Text, number, date, choices, ranking, rating, scale, matrix, file upload and signature.
Show fields based on earlier answers with when, or grade a form with points and explanations.
Submissions go to SQLite and JSONL, with charts and CSV or JSON export in the Responses tab.
Forward each submission over HTTP POST with an optional HMAC-SHA256 signature.
Change labels, options or required flags in the browser and they are saved into the TSX.
en.prompt: Make a registration form for our AI meetup with a dietary needs question

zh.display: 讓 Agent 寫的表單與問卷
zh.lede: 為 Coding Agent 打造的表單框架：描述你要的問卷、報名表或測驗，Agent 寫 TSX，open-form 處理版面、條件邏輯、驗證與回覆儲存。適合不想依賴線上表單服務收集回覆的人。
features: 同一份 TSX 可以是單頁表單、分步精靈，或一次一題的對話卡片。
文字、數字、日期、選擇、排序、評分、量表、矩陣、檔案上傳與簽名。
用 when 依前面的回答顯示題目，或以配分與解析把表單變成測驗。
提交內容寫入 SQLite 與 JSONL，回覆分頁有統計圖表，可匯出 CSV 或 JSON。
每筆回覆可用 HTTP POST 轉發，並可加上 HMAC-SHA256 簽章。
編輯模式改的是原始碼
在瀏覽器改標題、選項或必填，直接寫回 TSX。
zh.prompt: 幫我們的 AI 聚會做一份報名表，要問飲食需求

open-map.init: git clone https://github.com/simonliu-ai-product/open-map.git && cd open-map && pnpm install

en.display: Maps and story maps for agents
en.lede: A map framework for coding agents: your agent writes each map as a React component, and open-map handles projections, layers, guided story chapters and export. For people telling stories with places and routes.
features: Choropleth, route, arc, point and heatmap layers, plus markers and callouts, in plain TSX.
Web Mercator, equirectangular and an orthographic globe, with scale bar, north arrow and inset map.
Spatial files import as modules, and open-map import builds a new map from one.
StoryChapter stops turn a map into a guided tour with camera fly-to and keyboard navigation.
Click a feature to see its source line, leave a note, or save the current camera to source.
open-map dev --mcp exposes tools to list, read, write, check and import maps.
en.prompt: Map Taiwan's high-voltage grid with a story chapter for each region

zh.display: 讓 Agent 寫的地圖與敘事地圖
zh.lede: 為 Coding Agent 打造的地圖框架：Agent 把每張地圖寫成 React 元件，open-map 處理投影、圖層、故事導覽章節與匯出。適合用地點與路線說故事的人。
features: 分層設色、路線、弧線、點位與熱力圖層，加上標記與標註，都用 TSX 寫。
麥卡托、等距圓柱與正射地球儀，附比例尺、指北針與鷹眼圖。
空間資料可直接當模組匯入，open-map import 也能從檔案產生新地圖。
用 StoryChapter 把地圖變成導覽，鏡頭平滑飛移，可用鍵盤切換。
點任一圖徵看它的原始碼行號、留註解，或把目前視角存回原始碼。
open-map dev --mcp 提供列出、讀取、寫入、檢查與匯入地圖的工具。
zh.prompt: 畫一張台灣高壓電網地圖，每個區域一個故事章節

open-recording.dev: cd my-recordings && pnpm add -D @open-recording/core @open-recording/mcp && pnpm exec open-recording dev --mcp

en.lede: Record in the browser, transcribe locally with whisper.cpp, and let an agent drive both over MCP. For meetings and talks you want transcribed without sending audio anywhere.
features: A studio tab holds the microphone, and an agent can start and stop a recording.
whisper.cpp transcribes on your machine, so no audio leaves it.
Start, stop, transcribe, search transcripts and write notes beside the audio.
Capture a tab's picture and sound into one recording, transcribed and subtitled.
Each recording is a folder of audio, transcript and notes, with no database.
Download the audio, SRT, VTT or a timestamped Markdown transcript.
en.prompt: Record this meeting, then write a summary with action items next to it

zh.display: 給 Agent 用的錄音工作室
zh.lede: 在瀏覽器錄音，用 whisper.cpp 在本機轉錄，讓 Agent 透過 MCP 兩件都能自己來。適合想把會議或演講轉成逐字稿、又不想把音檔送出去的人。
features: 工作室分頁負責麥克風，Agent 可以自己開始與停止錄音。
whisper.cpp 在你的電腦上轉錄，音訊不離開這台機器。
給 Agent 的 MCP 工具
開始、停止、轉錄、搜尋逐字稿，並在音檔旁寫筆記。
把一個分頁的畫面與聲音錄成一段，一樣轉錄、一樣有字幕。
每段錄音是一個資料夾，裡面是音檔、逐字稿與筆記，沒有資料庫。
下載音檔、SRT、VTT，或帶時間戳的 Markdown 逐字稿。
zh.prompt: 幫我錄這場會議，結束後在旁邊寫一份摘要和待辦事項

alt.en: The open-recording studio: a list of recordings

open-design-frame.dev: cd my-frames && pnpm install && pnpm dev

en.lede: Each frame is a fixed-size artboard, such as a desktop screen, a phone screen or a poster, that your agent writes in TSX. The canvas draws it at true size and the inspector edits it by rewriting the file. For designers and developers who want the design and the code in one place.
features: Each frame carries its own size, and the canvas scales the view, never the contents.
Click any element, adjust it in the inspector, and Save rewrites the TSX.
Click through frames in a simulated browser or phone, following the links each frame declares.
Tokens become CSS variables, beside a DESIGN.md that tells an agent the rules tokens cannot hold.
Self-contained HTML, PNG at 1x, 2x and 3x, and SVG, each frame drawn at its own size.
open-design-frame dev --mcp exposes 32 tools, and stale writes are refused.
en.prompt: Design a mobile onboarding screen and a desktop pricing page

zh.lede: 每張 frame 都是固定尺寸的畫板，例如桌機畫面、手機畫面或海報，由 Agent 用 TSX 寫成；畫布以實際尺寸呈現，檢視器直接改寫原始檔。適合想讓設計稿與程式碼放在同一處的設計師與開發者。
features: 每張 frame 帶著自己的尺寸，畫布縮放的是外框，不是內容。
點任一元素、在檢視器調整，按 Save 就寫回 TSX。
在模擬的瀏覽器或手機裡點過一張張 frame，依 frame 自己宣告的連結走。
token 變成 CSS 變數，旁邊的 DESIGN.md 寫下 token 裝不下的規則給 Agent 看。
可獨立開啟的 HTML、1x／2x／3x 的 PNG 與 SVG，每張 frame 都以自己的尺寸輸出。
open-design-frame dev --mcp 提供 32 個工具，過期的寫入會被拒絕。
zh.prompt: 設計一個手機版引導頁和一個桌機版價格頁

alt.en: The open-design-frame canvas with the inspector open
